name: Where is the best place to position grab bars in a shower?

mainEntity.name: Where is the best place to position grab bars in a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Placement depends on how the user enters, exits, and moves inside the shower. A vertical grab bar is typically installed near the shower entryway or door frame at about 32 to 38 inches high to assist with stepping over the curb or tub ledge. A horizontal or diagonal bar is mounted along the main sidewall at a similar height to help someone stand or steady themselves while bathing. If a shower bench or seat is present, placing a bar horizontally alongside it makes sitting down and standing back up significantly easier.
acceptedAnswer.description: Place a vertical bar near the shower entrance to assist entry, and a horizontal or angled bar along the side wall between 32 and 38 inches high for balance.
